item.title: Stocks Edge Higher As Oil Drops On Fresh Mideast Hopes
item.description: Asian stocks edged higher Wednesday as oil prices extended a decline on receding concerns about another military flare-up between the United States and Iran, while traders were also nervously awaiting Nvidia's earnings and key US inflation data. Delivered by PolitePaul service

item.title: Redistricting Wars Shrink Voter Choice Ahead Of US Midterms
item.description: When Americans vote in November's midterm elections, all 435 seats in the House of Representatives will be on the ballot, but in much of the country the result is barely in doubt. Delivered by PolitePaul service
